title: Frame bounds and bandwidth tiling for time-causal bandpass wavelets
summary: Wavelets and frames that provide strong guarantees for signal representations are a cornerstone in signal processing theory, but have long been restricted to non-causal settings. Recent work extended wavelet analysis to time-causal systems that operate on streaming signals, with exact reconstruction and time-recursive implementations. However, the frame guarantees that make such representations reliable under noise and quantization are uncharacterized.
